Plan for schema app1: deployed 1.0.0 -> 1.0.3 (3 changesets, 32 statements)

== changeset 1.0.1  deltas/v1_0_1.json  [transaction]
-- tag documents and track their priority
-- [1] add enum tag_color  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create type tag_color as enum ('red', 'green', 'blue');
-- [1] comment enum tag_color
comment on type tag_color is 'Colors a tag can have';
-- [2] add sequence tag_seq  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create sequence tag_seq increment by 5 start with 1000 cache 10;
-- [2] comment sequence tag_seq
comment on sequence tag_seq is 'Numbers tags';
-- [3] table tags
create table if not exists tags (id integer primary key generated always as identity,document_id uuid not null,label text not null,color tag_color,seq_no bigint default nextval('tag_seq'));
-- [4] add column documents.priority  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
alter table documents add column if not exists priority integer default 0;
-- [4] comment column documents.priority
comment on column documents.priority is 'Higher is processed sooner';
-- [4] post-hook add column documents.priority
--   deltas/scripts/backfill_priority.sql:
update documents set priority = 1 where document_type = 'STRUCTURED';
update documents set priority = 0 where priority is null;
-- [5] add index documents.documents_type_idx  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create  index if not exists documents_type_idx on documents (document_type);
-- [end] sequence tag_seq owned by tags.seq_no  (deferred to the end of the changeset)
alter sequence tag_seq owned by tags.seq_no;
-- [end] fk tags.tags_document_fk  (deferred to the end of the changeset; tolerates 42710)
alter table tags add constraint tags_document_fk foreign key (document_id) references documents (id);

== changeset 1.0.2  deltas/v1_0_2.json  [transaction]
-- require a document type
-- [1] pre-hook alter column documents.document_type
update documents set document_type = 'UNSTRUCTURED' where document_type is null;
-- [1] alter column documents.document_type  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
alter table documents alter column document_type set NOT NULL;
-- [2] add constraint documents.documents_document_type_check  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
alter table documents add constraint documents_document_type_check check (document_type in ('STRUCTURED','UNSTRUCTURED'));
-- [3] rename column documents.location  (tolerates 42P07, 42710, 42703)
alter table documents rename column location to file_location;
-- [4] drop fk documents.documents_old_fk  (tolerates 42P07, 42710, 42704, 42P01)
alter table documents drop constraint documents_old_fk;
-- [5] script seed the default tags  (tolerates 23505)
insert into tags (document_id, label) select id, 'new' from documents;
delete from tags where label = 'obsolete';
-- [6] script tidy up orphaned tags
--   deltas/scripts/cleanup_tags.sql:
delete from tags t where not exists (select 1 from documents d where d.id = t.document_id);
-- [7] add comment on column documents.document_type  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
comment on column documents.document_type is 'STRUCTURED or UNSTRUCTURED - it''s required';
-- [8] drop comment on table tags  (tolerates 42P07, 42710, 42704, 42P01)
comment on table tags is null;
-- [9] alter enum tag_color (add value 'blue')  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
alter type tag_color add value if not exists 'blue' after 'green';
-- [10] alter sequence tag_seq  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
alter sequence tag_seq as bigint increment by 5 no minvalue no maxvalue cache 10 no cycle owned by tags.seq_no;

== changeset 1.0.3  deltas/v1_0_3.json  [NO TRANSACTION - a failure part way through is not rolled back]
-- index without locking and refresh the view
-- [1] script concurrent label index
create index concurrently if not exists tags_label_idx on tags (label);
-- [2] add function update_last_modified_at  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
--   state/sql/pre/update_last_modified_at.sql:
create or replace function update_last_modified_at() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin
  new.last_modified_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;
-- [3] add view project_documents  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create or replace view project_documents (project_name,document_id,document_type) as select p.name, d.id, d.document_type from projects p join documents d on d.project_id = p.id;
-- [3] comment view project_documents
comment on view project_documents is 'Documents per project';
-- [4] add matview document_counts  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create materialized view if not exists document_counts (document_type,n) as select document_type, count(*) from documents group by document_type with data;
-- [4] index document_counts.document_counts_type_idx
create unique index if not exists document_counts_type_idx on document_counts (document_type);
-- [4] comment matview document_counts
comment on materialized view document_counts is 'Documents per type';
-- [5] add view common_types  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
create or replace view common_types (document_type) as select document_type from document_counts where n > 1;
-- [6] refresh matview document_counts (concurrently)  (tolerates 42P07, 42710)
refresh materialized view concurrently document_counts;

WARNING: deltas/v1_0_2.json#/deltas/8: changeset 1.0.2 adds the value 'blue' to enum tag_color in a transaction - postgres does not let the value be used until the changeset commits, so use it in a later changeset
WARNING: changeset 1.0.3 runs without a transaction - a failure part way through leaves the earlier deltas in place
